title: Beyond Prompts: A Systematic Study of LLM-Based Machine Translation Evaluators
abstract: arXiv:2610.33741v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based evaluators have rapidly become a standard tool for machine translation evaluation, yet the design choices that shape their behavior remain poorly understood. We present a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect span-level and ranking-based MT evaluation. We collect new expert RATE annotations on WMT24 and WMT25 English-Russian translations, with transfer validation on MQM- and ESA-annotated benchmarks across five additional language pairs. Our experiments reveal four robust findings: instruction structure shapes evaluator behavior, high-quality demonstrations matter more than quantity, frontier backbones exhibit distinct evaluator profiles (recall-, precision-, or ranking-oriented), and fusing outputs across diverse backbones outperforms single-evaluator multi-call setups. translated_title: 超越提示词：基于大语言模型的机器翻译评估器的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型的评估器已迅速成为机器翻译评估的标准工具，但塑造其行为的设计选择仍然鲜为人知。我们对指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型选择以及多步骤工作流如何影响片段级和基于排序的机器翻译评估进行了系统研究。我们在WMT24和WMT25英俄翻译上收集了新的专家RATE标注，并在涵盖另外五个语言对的MQM和ESA标注基准上进行了迁移验证。我们的实验揭示了四个稳健的发现：指令结构塑造评估器行为，高质量示例比示例数量更重要，前沿骨干模型展现出各异的评估器特征（面向召回率、精确率或排序），并且融合多个不同骨干模型的输出优于单一评估器多次调用的设置。尽管评估器设计呈现出巨大的组合空间，但（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文系统研究了指令设计、少样本示例、骨干模型选择和多步骤工作流对基于大语言模型的机器翻译评估器的影响，发现指令结构、高质量示例、骨干模型的差异化评估特征以及跨模型输出融合是决定评估性能的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a systematic study of how instruction design, few-shot demonstrations, backbone model choice, and multi-step workflows affect LLM-based MT evaluators, revealing that instruction structure, demonstration quality, distinct backbone evaluator profiles, and output fusion across diverse backbones are key determinants of evaluation performance.
